citations.note: new in 1866. The Law Reports (Exchequer) have no source; linked by name to the same case in the English Reports, Parker (Devisee of Barrow) v Tootal, 3 H & C 913 (Exchequer, 1865), the costs-in-error stage at the end of Hurlstone and Coltman, preferred over the stub 1 L.R.Ex. 41. The other record of the name is the House of Lords appeal, 11 HLC 143 (1865); the footnote's subject (costs in error) and court pick the Exchequer record, but that it is the same report as L.R. 1 Ex. 41 is inferred, not checked
